reviews.reason: Checked vertexwise abelianness, finite path projectives, unique-first-arrow exactness and maximal-path injectivity of the length-one resolution. Endpoint-fixed block matrices identify Yoneda Ext1 with coker(partial); Baer sum and scalar pushout give its vector-space structure, so rank-nullity yields the Euler formula. Finite-field lexicographic orbit representatives supply a small finitary skeleton with only finite choices. Only the misleading title and owning manifest title mirror changed.

Checked quotient objects as product-GL torsors with equivariant arrow tuples; associated finite-dimensional vector spaces have bases, giving trivial frame torsors, and changes of bases give exactly representation isomorphisms and automorphism stabilizers. HN Frobenius descent gives equality of geometric and rational semistability for d nonzero; the repaired step 2.1 proves the zero case directly with trivial group and mass 1. AC remains inherited for openness only. Updated the owning Statement mirror and derivation/boundary contract. Bridgeland §4.4 includes zero in the additive semistable subcategories without defining its phase.

Checked the groupoid weight against J and the stack-point lemma including its repaired zero convention. Compared the four contextual theories with their actual local definitions: dg cofiber convolution with higher homotopy weights, motivic stack functions, intrinsic rational quotient-stack Borel–Moore operations, and unital algebra actions on separate modules. These are contextual distinctions; the remark uses none of their theorems as a premise for the arithmetic identity. Its conditional physical comparisons make no unsupported identification. The page-relative proof attribution is correct. Carrier unchanged.

Verified the rank decomposition of every linear map as S1^a direct-sum E^r direct-sum S2^b; E has the unique proper nonzero subobject S2. Strict between-phase comparison gives both chamber classifications; for sums of E the displayed determinant has the correct nonpositive sign. End(A)=F_q and chi(gamma,gamma)=1 give Ext1=0 and Aut(A^n)=GL_n. Counting ordered bases yields t^{n^2}/|GL_n|=t^n/product(t^{2r}-1), including n=0. Subobject-first decreasing HN factors and the skew relation x2*x1=t^2 x1*x2 give the stated pentagon. Infinitely many finite-field specializations justify the rational-function identity. The declared weighted basis licenses F3; carrier unchanged.
